title: Creole French at home, a lesson teacher and a home recording
summary: His mother spoke French; he sings Creole songs; he had a few lessons and a home recording with Giles.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
